findings.fsdQuote: A Random button on the library screen opens a randomly chosen series from that library.
findings.note: No random-series button exists in the library detail screen.

findings.fsdQuote: A slideshow mode turns the page automatically after a set number of seconds.
findings.note: No slideshow feature is found in the UI code.

findings.fsdQuote: Brightness can be set anywhere from 0% to 100%.
findings.note: The brightness (darkness) value is validated with a minimum of 10 and a maximum of 100.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No text-to-speech or speechSynthesis usage exists in the UI.

findings.fsdQuote: The owner can share a reading list through a public link that opens without signing in.
findings.note: No public sharing link for reading lists exists in the code.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The minimum password length is 6, set in the Identity options and in the DTOs.

findings.fsdQuote: Changing the password requires the current password and is only open to administrators and users with the Change Password role.
findings.note: The server allows a self password change only for the ChangePassword role or admin, and requires the old password for non-admins.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The download size warning threshold is 100 MB (104,857,600 bytes), not 500 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Prompt for Re-Reads sets after how many days without progress Kavita offers to re-read, and 0 turns the prompt off.
findings.note: A promptForRereadsAfter field exists with minimum 0.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: I found no maintenance mode setting or switch. The only 'maintenance' hit in the server code is a comment about nightly maintenance work.

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The General settings page has no Save step: form changes are auto-saved after a 300 ms debounce whenever the form is valid.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30
findings.note: Total backups and total logs are validated with min 1 and max 30.

findings.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
findings.note: Cache size has a minimum validator of 50.

findings.fsdQuote: A Reset to Default button restores these settings after a confirmation.
findings.note: resetToDefaults asks for confirmation and then calls the server reset.

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30 and both default to 30.
findings.note: Both fields are validated min 1 / max 30 and seeded with 30.

findings.fsdQuote: An invite can be given an expiry date, after which its link stops working.
findings.note: The invite user form has no expiry date field.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The new library form defaults manageCollections to false.

findings.fsdQuote: Include in Dashboard and Include in Search are turned on by default.
findings.note: The new library form defaults both includeInDashboard and includeInSearch to true.

findings.fsdQuote: Each type starts with its own file types:
findings.note: The default file types per library type are Manga: Archive and Images; Comic and ComicVine: Archive; Book: Pdf and Epub; Images: Images; Light Novel: Epub. This matches the table.

findings.fsdQuote: a library cannot be saved without at least one folder and at least one file type.
findings.note: Validation checks both folders and file types are non-empty.
